bonuses.name: Mechanical Assistance
bonuses.text: A Scarab can use the Help any Necron within 10m as a Free Action.

bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

abilities.name: Self-Destruction
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to activate a Canoptek Scarab or a Mob of Canoptek Scarabs self-destruction protocols, causing them to explode with the following profile: 4 +1 ED / Blast (2). For every additional Scarab that self destructs, increase the ED and Blast Rating by +1.

abilities.name: Reanimation Protocols
abilities.text: When this Threat is destroyed, roll a d6. If the result is an Exalted Icon, it is resurrected with 1 Wound and 1 Shock.
